description: Compare agentic payment protocols (AP2, ACP/Shared Payment Token, x402, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay) across credential, signing, scope, rail, identity, and audit dimensions; optionally recommend a fit for a scenario. Read-only local lookup and comparison — no state change, no keys held, nothing sent or registered anywhere. Use when a developer or strategist needs to orient across the fragmenting agentic-payments standards. Renders the interactive AINumbers tool as a widget; inputs are applied via the AIN Bridge and the tool runs client-side (zero PII, zero network). Output schema: call describe_tool("compare_agentic_payment_protocols").
